% Compute transitive closure of role inclusion
role_includes(R1, R2) :- includes(R1, R2).
role_includes(R1, R2) :- includes(R1, R3), role_includes(R3, R2).

% Get all roles for a user (direct from group + transitive includes)
user_has_role(U, R) :- member(U, G), grant(G, R).
user_has_role(U, R) :- member(U, G), grant(G, R1), role_includes(R1, R).

% Check if user can perform action on resource (before revocation)
can_perform_without_revoke(U, Res, A) :- user_has_role(U, Role), permit(Role, Res, A).

% Check if user can perform action on resource (after applying revocations)
can_perform(U, Res, A) :- can_perform_without_revoke(U, Res, A), not revoked(U, Res).

% Find pairs where user can delete but not read

% Query the answer

% Find all roles that directly permit the "read" action on the target resource
can_read_directly(Role) :-
  permit(Role, "r27de0005", "read").

% Find all roles that transitively include a role that can read the resource
can_read_transitively(Role) :-
  includes(Role, IncludedRole),
  can_read_directly(IncludedRole).

can_read_transitively(Role) :-
  includes(Role, IncludedRole),
  can_read_transitively(IncludedRole).

% A role can read if it can do so directly or transitively
can_read(Role) :-
  can_read_directly(Role).

can_read(Role) :-
  can_read_transitively(Role).

% A user has a role if they are in a group that is granted that role
user_has_role(User, Role) :-
  member(User, Group),
  grant(Group, Role).

% A user can read the resource if they have a role that can read it
can_read_resource(User) :-
  user_has_role(User, Role),
  can_read(Role).

% Final answer: users who can read the resource, excluding revoked users
answer(User) :-
  can_read_resource(User),
  not revoked(User, "r27de0005").

import "grant.csv" as grant.
import "includes.csv" as includes.
import "member.csv" as member.
import "permit.csv" as permit.
import "revoked.csv" as revoked.

% A user has a role if they are in a group that is granted it
user_role(User, Role) :- member(User, Group), grant(Group, Role).

% A role includes another role transitively
role_includes(Role, IncludedRole) :- includes(Role, IncludedRole).
role_includes(Role, IncludedRole) :- role_includes(Role, IntermediateRole), includes(IntermediateRole, IncludedRole).

% A role permits an action on a resource if:
% 1. The role directly permits it, OR
% 2. The role includes another role that permits it
role_permits(Role, Resource, Action) :- permit(Role, Resource, Action).
role_permits(Role, Resource, Action) :- role_includes(Role, IncludedRole), role_permits(IncludedRole, Resource, Action).

% A user can perform an action on a resource if:
% 1. They have a role that permits it, AND
% 2. They are not revoked for that resource
user_can(User, Resource, Action) :-
  user_role(User, Role),
  role_permits(Role, Resource, Action),
  not revoked(User, Resource).

% Find users who can read r27de0014
answer(User) :- user_can(User, r27de0014, read).

import "applicant.csv" as applicant.
import "sanction.csv" as sanction.

% An applicant qualifies if:
% 1. age >= 30 (and age is present)
% 2. income < 36000 (and income is present)
% 3. residency_years >= 4 (and residency_years is present)
% 4. not in sanction.csv

qualifies(ID) :-
  applicant(id: ID, age: Age, income: Income, residency_years: ResidencyYears),
  Age is not absent,
  Age >= 30,
  Income is not absent,
  Income < 36000,
  ResidencyYears is not absent,
  ResidencyYears >= 4,
  not sanction(applicant: ID, reason: _).

?- answer(ID) :- qualifies(ID).

% Import customer and order data
import "customer.csv" as customer.
import "order.csv" as order(id: string, customer: string, ordered_on: @date, amount: float).

% Find customers who placed at least one order in the target date range
ordered_in_range(C) :-
    order(_, C, DateOrdered, _),
    DateOrdered >= @2026-06-01,
    DateOrdered <= @2026-10-28.

% Find customers who did NOT place any order in the date range
answer(CustomerID) :-
    customer(CustomerID, _),
    not ordered_in_range(CustomerID).

import "order.csv" as order.
import "shipment.jsonl" as shipment.

% Find orders that shipped more than 10 days after ordering
late_order(OrderId) :-
    order(id: OrderId, ordered_on: OrderedDate),
    shipment(order: OrderId, shipped_on: ShippedDate),
    ShippedDate is not absent,
    OrderedDate is not absent,
    Days = (ShippedDate - OrderedDate) / @1d,
    Days > 10.

?- late_order(OrderId).

% Import the CSV files
import "instance.csv" as instance.
import "subclass.csv" as subclass.
import "disjoint.csv" as disjoint.

% Compute all superclasses transitively (including a class as its own superclass)
superclass_of(C, C).
superclass_of(C, S) :- subclass(C, S).
superclass_of(C, S) :- subclass(C, S1), superclass_of(S1, S).

% Compute all classes an instance belongs to (direct + inherited)
belongs_to(I, C) :- instance(I, C1), superclass_of(C1, C).

% Find instances that belong to two disjoint classes
answer(I) :- belongs_to(I, C1), belongs_to(I, C2), disjoint(C1, C2).

import "subclass.csv" as subclass.
import "instance.csv" as instance.

% Transitive subclass relationship
% Direct subclass relationship
is_subclass_of(X, Y) :- subclass(X, Y).

% Transitive: if X is subclass of Y and Y is subclass of Z, then X is subclass of Z
is_subclass_of(X, Z) :- subclass(X, Y), is_subclass_of(Y, Z).

% An instance I is an instance of k27demix0 if:
% 1. I is directly an instance of k27demix0, OR
% 2. I is an instance of some class C that is a subclass of k27demix0
answer(I) :- instance(I, "k27demix0").
answer(I) :- instance(I, C), is_subclass_of(C, "k27demix0").
